candidate_schema.precedent_status: Dated untried alternative from run 7; no historical Phase-D result is assumed.
candidate_schema.feature_source: Frozen inter-residue sulfur-role RBF channel evaluated from the target HN coordinate.
candidate_schema.feature_formula: For center c, let z_k,t,c be the existing nonnegative inter-residue S-role channel sum(rbf_c)/sqrt(max(S_role_count,1)). Define f_k,t,c = 1 - exp(-z_k,t,c), which is smooth and in [0,1).
candidate_schema.correction_formula: support_mean_corrected_k,t = support_mean_k,t + I[support_gate] * sign * 0.005 * f_k,t,c ppm
candidate_schema.application_stage: Apply to support means after posterior q is computed.
candidate_schema.q4_handling: Q4 is retained only as the dated route-provenance label. No unavailable old-chart quantile or threshold is reconstructed.

exclusions.reason: The old route reached its configured maximum, no exchange-state label exists, and no independent train-to-inner-dev counterfactual supporting a distinct acceptor-geometry realization was supplied.
Although inter-residue sulfur geometry is available, the old chart was maxed and the required independent counterfactual for adding a distinct correction has not yet been established.
The frozen surface has no aromatic ring-current scalar or sufficient ring representation.
The frozen surface has no alignment-mismatch feature.
No named dated candidate precedent or terminal-state representation is available.

leakage_notes: The menu uses only dated precedents, frozen target metadata, and frozen support-conformer geometry; no current or outer result is used.
Centers, width, signs, magnitude, gates, and IDs are fixed before evaluation.
The separately supplied compass is used only as direction corroborated by the dated PHE sulfur precedent.

Later selection must use only inner-train and inner-dev folds and require improvement with the same candidate sign in all three folds, lower Student-t objective, and no worsening of HN raw or standardized p95 or max.
Because the correction is HN/PHE-gated and post-q, C', CA, CB, N, posterior q, ESS, and entropy must remain exactly invariant.
If no candidate satisfies every selection guard, the required outcome is NO_CANDIDATE.
